question: What light value did sensor 6.0 measure on 2004-03-01 at 03:10:16?
graph_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 6.0})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-03-01T03:10:16"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.light AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
